text: U.K. annual inflation reached 3.1% in August. Motor fuel prices rose 23% y/y and household energy costs rose 6%, while food and non-alcoholic beverage inflation stood at 1.1%. The 10-year gilt yield was 5.365% and the 30-year 5.907%.

meta.note: Energy-intensive and broader inflation measures remain uneven across the reported basket.

text: EU Commission President Ursula von der Leyen proposed Canada as the EU's first associate member, extending cooperation beyond CETA across economic security, defense, technology, energy and the Arctic. The proposed status does not currently exist in EU treaties.

meta.note: Associate membership remains undefined and would require agreement on its institutional and legal form.

text: The FOMC voted 12-0 to raise the federal funds target 25 bps to 3.75%-4%, its first increase since 2023. September projections place 12 participants at a 4.125% year-end midpoint, while the statement identifies inflation as elevated.

meta.note: The enacted hike is fixed; subsequent rate settings remain projections rather than policy actions.

text: The House approved by unanimous consent a contempt resolution against Leon Black over noncompliance with two Oversight subpoenas in its Epstein investigation. The committee had advanced the resolution 41-0; the matter proceeds to DOJ for possible prosecution.

meta.note: The contempt filing is complete; any criminal prosecution remains a separate DOJ determination.
